card.name: Timing words in contraception and prophylaxis advice
card.fires_on: The word "treatment" after "during" in advice to use contraception while on a drug. Also "before" after a number of days or weeks in malaria prophylaxis start instructions.

modes.label: Contraception during treatment
modes.description: The word "treatment" after "during" in advice to use effective contraception, followed by "with [drug] and for" a period afterward.
modes.example: Females of reproductive potential should use effective contraception during<< treatment>> with SCEMBLIX and for

modes.label: Start before travel
modes.description: The word "before" after a time span in malaria prophylaxis start instructions.
modes.example: Prophylaxis Treatment must start 2 weeks<< before>> travel to an endemic area. Advise

card.writes: It seems to favor linking words that extend a phrase, such as "and" or "plus", so a second item or period follows.
card.plain: It marks the point in a sentence where a time frame is named and a second time frame is likely to be added with "and".
